attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Determine if corporation must file Florida state corporate tax return. Checks for physical presence or economic nexus.

condition_details.condition_comment: Has physical presence in FL (office, employees, property)
condition_details.condition_postfix: apportionment.has_physical_presence true beq { pop apportionment.state_code "FL" streq } over if

condition_details.condition_comment: Meets FL economic nexus threshold ($50K or 200 transactions)
condition_details.condition_postfix: apportionment.has_economic_nexus true beq { pop apportionment.state_code "FL" streq } over if

attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Calculate Florida state corporate income tax. Applies FL 5.5% flat rate to apportioned and adjusted taxable income.

condition_details.condition_comment: Must have nexus to owe tax; apportionment.has_economic_nexus is true or apportionment.has_physical_presence is true
condition_details.condition_postfix: apportionment.has_economic_nexus true beq { pop apportionment.has_physical_presence true beq } over not if

action_details.action_comment: Florida 5.5% flat rate calculation; // Florida uses 5.5% flat rate; set apportionment.state_tax = apportionment.state_taxable_income * apportionment.state_tax_rate - apportionment.state_credits; set apportionment.state_refund_or_owed = apportionment.state_payments - apportionment.state_tax;
action_details.action_dsl: if apportionment.state_taxable_income * apportionment.state_tax_rate - apportionment.state_credits > 0.0 then set apportionment.state_tax = apportionment.state_taxable_income * apportionment.state_tax_rate - apportionment.state_credits; else set apportionment.state_tax = 0.0; endif set apportionment.state_refund_or_owed = apportionment.state_payments - apportionment.state_tax;
action_details.action_postfix: { apportionment.state_taxable_income apportionment.state_tax_rate fmul apportionment.state_credits f- cvd /apportionment.state_tax xdef } { 0.0 cvd /apportionment.state_tax xdef } apportionment.state_taxable_income apportionment.state_tax_rate fmul apportionment.state_credits f- 0.0 f> ifelse apportionment.state_payments apportionment.state_tax f- cvd /apportionment.state_refund_or_owed xdef

action_details.action_comment: No nexus - no tax liability; // No nexus - no tax liability; set apportionment.state_tax = 0.0; set apportionment.state_refund_or_owed = apportionment.state_payments;
No taxable income - no tax liability; // No taxable income - no tax liability; set apportionment.state_tax = 0.0; set apportionment.state_refund_or_owed = apportionment.state_payments;
